proposed_go_requirements: Parent explicitly authorizes fixture execution and supplies exact held candidate source manifest and helper pins.
Implementation owner declares held-stable; no candidate/source freeze implied by this plan.
Independent fixtures live outside candidate and run with new short own temp/output paths.
Provider invocation uses explicit synthetic records only; never CodexProvider.complete or model authentication.
Candidate/evaluation/semantic audits are not monkeypatched to force positives. External transport/process dependencies may be synthetic only and qualification remains ineligible.
Any tiny trusted CPU engineering component is explicit synthetic/public array scope and is counted separately from actual research trials.
Protected historical files are checked by parent-held source-only metadata guard; no old owner/raw data or existing 309 source bodies are opened by preparation.
evidence_plan: Exact source/helper hashes before and after each independent execution.
Per-family expected verdict, observed rejection/normalization, origin call/source binding, provider counters and tape event counts.
Raw unittest/stdout/stderr/command/guard logs and family-to-subcase mapping; source changes invalidate stable proof.
Native B/C AST/module pin comparison and explicit changed-file diff scope; original upstream native algorithm bodies remain pinned.
Failures preserved as immutable attempt receipts; no silent fixture/criteria change or success phase replay.
cautions: A handcrafted Recorder positive alone does not test the original integration defect; actual callback writers are mandatory.
Synthetic structural acceptance is never actual semantic completion or adoption.
Local rehash resistance is tested against independent fixed anchors; it is not a claim that arbitrary wholly self-consistent untrusted histories are secure without external pins.
An eventual engineering pass does not identify one repair's causal research benefit; fresh matched development remains necessary.
